page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance generally delivers modest performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the server in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories respectively. Memory read bandwidth is also relatively low, though large-block memory write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip, show poor performance, while Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests achieve average ratings.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is its high memory capacity paired with relatively weak compute performance. This resource density makes it qualitatively cost-effective for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU throughput. It is suited for caching layers, lightweight database operations, and small-scale LLM inference using models under 1B parameters, but it is less optimal for compute-heavy tasks, large-scale compilation, or high-throughput web serving.
